title: After the street food festival
instructions:
Write your answer in 220-260 words in an appropriate style.

You helped as a volunteer at your town's first street food festival. The organising committee has asked volunteers to write a report about the event.

In your report, you should describe what worked well, explain the main problems visitors and stallholders experienced, and recommend changes for next year's festival.

Write your report.
inputText:
From the organising committee:

Thank you for helping at the festival. Around 8,000 people came, far more than we expected. Before we plan next year's event, we would like an honest report from the volunteers who were there on the day.
